description: This file implements the AddressInfo class and related functions for DNS address resolution, including iterators, constructors, and methods for handling address info, as well as a helper class for getaddrinfo calls.

classes.name: AddressInfo
classes.description: Represents DNS address information, providing iteration over addrinfo structures, address resolution, and address list creation.

classes.name: AddressInfo::const_iterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing addrinfo linked list.

classes.name: AddrInfoGetter
classes.description: Helper class to perform getaddrinfo system calls, supporting network-specific lookups on Android.

methods.name: AddressInfo::Get
methods.description: Performs DNS address resolution for a given host and hints, returning AddressInfo and status.

methods.name: AddressInfo::begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to start of addrinfo list.

methods.name: AddressInfo::end
methods.description: Returns iterator to end of addrinfo list.

methods.name: AddressInfo::GetCanonicalName
methods.description: Retrieves the canonical name of the address, if available.

methods.name: AddressInfo::IsAllLocalhostOfOneFamily
methods.description: Checks if all addrinfo entries are localhost addresses of a single family.

methods.name: AddressInfo::CreateAddressList
methods.description: Creates an AddressList object from the addrinfo entries.

methods.name: AddrInfoGetter::getaddrinfo
methods.description: Performs system call to resolve address info, supporting network-specific queries on Android.
